evals.name: cpu-load-regression-from-defect
evals.prompt: 帮我基于缺陷 D2804379 创建一个测试用例，link 到 feature 2811042。先读一下这个缺陷的内容，生成测试用例的 description 和 steps 给我看一下，先别写入 Octane。
evals.expected_output: A structured HTML description (Objective, Reference, Preconditions, baseline/regression tables, pass/fail criteria) and a plain-text steps script with [PreCon]/action/? lines, generated from defect 2804379's CPU load regression info. No Octane write occurs.

evals.name: drivetrain-defect-to-test
evals.prompt: 从 defect 2609066 (CCM Drivetrain limited power reduction, High severity) 生成一个测试用例的草稿，我要先 review 内容再决定写不写。本地 DB 里应该有这个缺陷。
evals.expected_output: Reads defect 2609066 from local SQLite, generates a description + steps draft focused on reproducing/verifying the drivetrain power reduction issue. Shows the content to the user without writing to Octane.

evals.name: offline-draft-with-explicit-fields
evals.prompt: I have a defect in mind but it's not in the DB yet. The defect is D2762063, name 'speech can not wakeup', severity Medium, software_version pu2707_i420-26w32.1-1, ECU IDCEVO-25, lead_model NA5. Can you draft a test case description and steps from this? Just the content, don't write to Octane.
evals.expected_output: Uses the user-provided fields directly (no DB read needed since defect details are given inline), generates a description + steps draft. Should handle the case where the defect isn't in the local DB gracefully.
